name: Site-to-site LDAP latency gauge
description: Latest reported latency per selected source DC and target DC, then average by source/target site direction. Gauge thresholds complement the existing honeycomb and trend; workspaces remain separate.
kql:
LatencyReports_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, TargetDC
| summarize Value = avg(todouble(Latency_ms)), Timestamp = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceSite, TargetSite
| project Timestamp, Series = strcat(SourceSite, ' -> ', TargetSite), Value
| order by Value desc
